translations.web: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
translations.bsb: In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
translations.kjv: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
translations.asv: And it shall be at that day, saith Jehovah, that thou shalt call me Ishi, and shalt call me no more Baali.
